mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, email, password_hash, nickname, status, is_deleted) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1
